everyday.density: one compact conversational paragraph; normally no list
everyday.guidance: 直接回应当前请求，保持自然简洁；不主动扩展建议或背景。

logic.density: state conclusion, then only the minimum supporting steps
logic.guidance: 先给结论，再给必要的最短推理；不要添加题目之外的事实。

philosophy.density: one bounded framing with a concise qualification when needed
philosophy.guidance: 给出一个有边界的观点，保留合理余地；不要写成小论文。
